visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a grey shirt walks toward the entrance of a retro-style ice shop featuring wooden furniture and traditional red signage. (2) Close-up shots focus on a bowl being prepared with large portions of dark red beans over a bed of shaved ice on a wooden table. (3) A man in a red t-shirt and blue jeans carries a bowl, while hands are seen pouring liquid syrup and condensed milk from plastic bottles over the ice. (4) The scene transitions to a detailed view of a spoon digging into the ice, showing the soft texture of the beans and the brown syrup coating the grains of ice. (5) A frozen red bean ice bar in a plastic sleeve is squeezed out and placed directly into a bowl of white snow ice topped with red beans. (6) The camera pans across the shopfront showing green-framed windows, a traditional ice-shaving machine, and multiple banners and signs with Chinese text.
